definitions.explanation: Having all necessary equipment, facilities, or features in place. Often used in real estate listings and facility descriptions.

examples.japanese: {設備|せつび}が{完備|かんび}している。
{防災|ぼうさい}{設備|せつび}を{完備|かんび}したビルに{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}した。
examples.english: We moved to a building fully equipped with disaster prevention facilities.

notes:
COLLOCATIONS:
- {設備|せつび}{完備|かんび}: fully equipped facilities
- エアコン{完備|かんび}: air conditioning included
- {冷暖房|れいだんぼう}{完備|かんび}: heating and air conditioning equipped

Frequently seen in property listings and hotel descriptions.
